data.body:
F01 and F06 refinement checkpoint. Analysis remains pinned to repository commit `6fb4d801c9`.

F01 must define two separate axes. Artifact roles cover tickets, ADRs, internal documentation, external documentation, shipped help, comments, generated artifacts, and protected evidence. Lifecycle classes preserve living reference, policy, design rationale, and historical evidence. For every role the policy must define audience, lifecycle, canonical source, citation practice, correction method, exclusions, and examples. Maintained current-state content is corrected at its canonical source. Ticket corrections use new events. ADR corrections use dated annotations, errata, or supersession without erasing decision substance. Generated output changes through its source. Protected evidence retains its payload and receives adjacent correction or provenance metadata. No current checker enforces protected-evidence correction semantics.

F06 must retain the intent router, the three-row troubleshooting table, the four lifecycle labels, and the three named historical files exactly once under `Historical evidence`. It must retain both generated-artifact subsection headings and their tables because focused tests parse them. It must route clients, contributors, architecture, ADRs, operations, research, and evidence without restating page content or duplicating generated catalogs. The index and AGENTS.md must name seven relations or defer to the canonical ticket model. A changed route model also requires correction of the root README description that says the index is grouped by four audiences.

Existing enforcement covers top-level docs index membership, relative links within docs, a focused test for links outside docs, DCO identity, deprecated criteria vocabulary, and generated-table row parity. The criteria vocabulary checker scans a new top-level policy file and rejects the retired criteria phrase. No other test pins the route or troubleshooting headings. No project file changed. No gate or review operation ran.
